identitySignals: Website www.ebfoa.com is titled East Bay Football Officials Association (EBFOA), an exact match to the agenda name and abbreviation

Site describes high school football officiating in the East Bay and meetings held at Oakland Tech, matching the agenda location (Oakland, CA) and the Oakland Athletic League football officiating contracts
research.notes: Registry lookups (ProPublica, CA SOS, SAM.gov) could not be done: web search budget was exhausted and ProPublica returned HTTP 429. Website was found by direct URL, not by search, and no independent page linking it to OUSD was found. The only contact email on the site appears to belong to an individual, so it was not used. Legal name, org type, EIN and entity number unconfirmed.

profile.summary: An association that supports high school football officiating in the East Bay region of California. It trains game officials and organizes meetings and clinics during the football season. It also gives two annual $1,000 scholarships to student-athletes.
